title: PG&E Corporation Form 8-K — Q1 2026 Financial Results
summary: PG&E Corporation filed a Form 8-K on April 23, 2026, reporting Q1 2026 financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, along with a webcast conference call and slide presentation for investors. This is a routine corporate earnings disclosure with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
